summary: Read-only pre-deploy sanity pass of the preview UI (frontend only, no code changes). Professional approval.test.pro1: logs in with password, dashboard loads, training banner is not shown because training is current (v2026-10-16.1). require_training() is a no-op, so nothing is blocked. Case page, safety hub, safety review and screening-responses pages all open with no 428/training_required (the responses page returns a correct 404 'No safety screening on file' because the DB has 0 safety_screenings). Reminder email preview and the POST /joint/invitations/preview template both say 'expires in 14 days'. The listed parent e2e.align.test1@gmail.com does NOT exist in the Align DB, so login gives 'Invalid email or password'. I used an existing seeded parent instead (t_pa_4ad1cd@example.com / testpass123, case SA-26-EDU-JJ3D3X). For that parent the page shows title 'Family check-in', the gate question, 'Yes, continue', 'Not now (remind me in the app later)' and 'Quick exit', and the 8 domains plus 'Before you start' and 'Optional' (21 items). There is no A/B/C choice screen for that parent. Judge judge.ui.preview: privacy notice consent comes first, then the court dashboard loads. There is no 'Urgent text alerts'/SMS card, and no SMS-related text or testids. Court case list (4), case switching, report cards, the message thread and the communication summary all load. The login page shows the Google button, but its label is 'Continue with Google'. No real console errors; the only noise is the expected 401 on /auth/me before login, a Cloudflare beacon CSP block and a visual-editor hydration warning.

ui_bugs.issue: Professional can still assign 'Version A (women)', 'Version B (men)' and 'Version C (LGBTQ+ relationship)' per parent. The backend /safety-screening/assign still accepts A/B/C.

25 parent slots in the DB have safety_version A/B, are unconfirmed and have no screening. Example: SA-26-COM-6VGPSV parent A = 'B', in pro1's own case. _status() returns choice_needed=True for these, so those parents will still get the 'Which questions fit your situation best?' A/B/C (women/men/LGBTQ+) choice screen. I checked this through the pro's API view, not through the parent UI, because no legacy parent password is known.
The judge tour step 'Court directory & urgent alerts' still says 'enable urgent-safety SMS alerts'. This is stale Twilio copy.
Dashboard 'Unopened invitations' text says 'a fresh link resets the 7-day window', but the expiry is now 14 days.
